_comment: A brief describes one consistent SET of images. Everything shared by the set lives at the top; only what changes per image goes in 'images'. Keeping it this way is what stops page 7 from looking like a different book. 'variant' is 'full' or 'lightning' (Qwen-Image-2512's two speed tiers) - lightning here since this is a fast flat-vector pack; the negative prompt is unused at this tier.
